correlates.name: Superior sulcus tumor with sympathetic chain involvement
correlates.presentation: A 63-year-old man with 50 pack-years has 3 months of deep right shoulder and upper chest pain and 4-kg weight loss. His right upper lid droops, the right pupil is smaller than the left, the right eye looks sunken, and the right side of his face does not sweat.
correlates.workup: Chest film and CT: a mass at the extreme right lung apex eroding the posterior first and second ribs and extending into the soft tissue at the root of the neck; biopsy may show any non-small cell type.

correlates.name: Superior vena cava syndrome
correlates.presentation: A 59-year-old woman with 45 pack-years has 3 weeks of swelling of her face, neck and both arms, worse when she bends forward or lies flat, with headache and a full feeling in her head. Plethoric face; dilated veins over the upper chest wall; legs not swollen. BP 142/86.
correlates.workup: Contrast CT: a right paratracheal and hilar mass compressing and invading the large vein draining the head and arms, with collateral veins across the chest wall.

correlates.name: Bronchial carcinoid tumor
correlates.presentation: A 50-year-old man who has never smoked has had a week of breathlessness with wheeze heard mainly on the right near the midline, and several watery stools a day with bouts of facial flushing; no weight loss. SpO2 95%. CT: a 3-cm mass projecting into the right main bronchus.
correlates.workup: Bronchoscopic biopsy: nests and ribbons of uniform cells with ample cytoplasm and finely stippled chromatin in a delicate fibrovascular stroma; fewer than 2 mitoses per 10 HPF and no necrosis; chromogranin and synaptophysin positive.
correlates.management: Surgical resection; the typical low-grade form generally behaves well. Only about 10% cause flushing and diarrhea.

correlates.name: Pulmonary hamartoma
correlates.presentation: A 47-year-old man with no symptoms has a 1.8-cm smooth, sharply outlined round peripheral nodule on a chest film taken for a work physical. Never smoked; exam normal; no weight loss.
correlates.workup: Resection: disorganized lobules of mature hyaline cartilage mixed with fat and fibrous tissue, with slit-like clefts lined by entrapped bronchial epithelium; no atypia.
correlates.management: Benign; once the diagnosis is established it needs no further treatment.

correlates.name: Metastatic tumor to the lung
correlates.presentation: A 64-year-old woman who had a sigmoid colon resection for cancer 2 years ago has 2 months of exertional dyspnea, dry cough and 5-kg weight loss. SpO2 93%. Chest film: many round, well-defined nodules of varying sizes scattered through both lungs.
correlates.workup: CT-guided biopsy of one nodule: tan-white tissue of malignant glands matching the earlier bowel primary; TTF-1 negative.
